scope: Share MTEXT group-3/group-1 chunk emission between standalone MTEXT and embedded ATTRIB/ATTDEF while preserving target encoding, character and transport bounds, and outer record framing.

method.kind: Local implementation with generated in-memory/tag-stream controls
method.gitCommitLimitation: The shared worktree was already broadly dirty and Git metadata is read-only in this environment.

implementation.change: Added writeUtf8MTextChunks with independent encoded-byte and source-character limits; extended the internal strict encoder with optional source-character accounting and short-final-chunk behavior.

Implemented one MTEXT chunking path for strict and compatibility text-write policies. It emits group-3 continuations followed by exactly one group 1, preserves encoded scalar boundaries, keeps an exactly-250-character input in group 1, and moves the last complete scalar to a short group-1 tail when continuation output would otherwise end with a full 250-character group.
Replaced the standalone MTEXT strict/compatibility duplicate loops and embedded-MTEXT single-group-1 write with the shared helper.
Added generated helper boundary controls and composed standalone MTEXT, ATTRIB and ATTDEF output checks for ASCII and Binary DXF, including a following LINE sentinel.
